payload.comment: Ingestion stage is internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass: split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution exactly; n_classes=9 matches the 9 listed labels; n_channels=3 is consistent with the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST resolution; subsampled=false confirms full-dataset use; selected_index_sha256 values are present for all three splits; archive_md5 and data_reference (Zenodo) are recorded. No deterministic findings were raised. One minor reproducibility gap: llm_model_digest is null while llm_model is set to 'qwen3.8'. This does not affect the ingestion stage itself, but downstream stages that rely on the LLM will lack a verifiable model-weights fingerprint. Recommend populating the digest before the first LLM-dependent stage executes. The test_domain_note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is an expected domain-shift disclosure and is properly documented. No action-blocking issues identified; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null; the exact Qwen model weights used cannot be verified for reproducibility in downstream LLM-dependent stages
llm_model name 'qwen3.8' is non-standard relative to publicly documented Qwen release naming; verify it resolves to the intended checkpoint on the Ollama instance
